name: clean-my-repo
description: Remove AI-generated slop from text. Subtractive only — preserves facts, code, quotes, and the author's voice.

interface.longDescription: Removes AI writing patterns (filler openers, hedging, AI-favorite words, sentence-structure tells, chatbot artifacts) while preserving facts, code, quotes, and the author's voice. Subtractive only — never adds content or rewrites for style.
defaultPrompt: Clean up the AI slop in this text.
Make this sound less like AI.
